lines.text: Paul came to Ephesus, found disciples who had received John's baptism, and when he laid hands on them, the Holy Spirit came.
Paul spoke boldly in the synagogue for six months, and then left with his disciples when some refused to believe.
Paul held daily discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus for two years, and everyone in the province of Asia heard the word.
Seven sons of Sceva tried to command an evil spirit by Jesus, whom Peter proclaims, and fled naked and wounded.
Fear came over everyone in Ephesus, and those who had practiced magic arts burned their books in front of everyone.
